note: Pressurised coolant leaking from a hull breach. A narrow high-velocity nozzle column that flares into a mushrooming head. The aux channel is CONDENSATE: it is zero at the nozzle and grows downstream as the jet expands and flashes, so the effect reads clear-and-fast at the breach and bright-and-slow at the head - the opposite gradient to combustion. Baked past its transient so the captured frames loop. Edit this file and re-run `node tools/bake-gas-volumes.mjs`.
